prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for children. The FKGL score of the output (Flesh-Kincaid Grade Level) approximates the reading grade of the text, using the following formula: 0.39 x (words/sentences) + 11.8 x (syllables/words) – 15.59. Target FKGL score of your simplification equals 5.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying how the brain works. Scientists like to use mice because they are easier to control and study. Usually, researchers choose to use male mice instead of female mice. This is because they worry that female mice might behave differently because of their hormone cycle, which could mess up the experiment results.
